# GuideKit

> AI-powered user guidance SDK — DOM intelligence, LLM orchestration, voice, and visual guidance for web apps.

GuideKit is a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo. Published packages live under `packages/`. Integration docs and examples live under `apps/`.

## Agent entry points

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent onboarding, architecture rules, validation checklist
- [skills/guidekit/SKILL.md](skills/guidekit/SKILL.md): Monorepo skill for AI agents
- [Architecture docs](apps/docs/app/docs/architecture/page.mdx): Public SDK architecture
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup, testing, changesets

## Core packages

- [@guidekit/cli](packages/cli/README.md): CLI tools for GuideKit SDK — init, doctor, generate-secret
- [@guidekit/core](packages/core/README.md): Core engine for GuideKit SDK — DOM intelligence, LLM orchestration, context management
- [@guidekit/intelligence](packages/intelligence/README.md): Semantic page intelligence engine for GuideKit SDK
- [@guidekit/knowledge](packages/knowledge/README.md): Knowledge base with BM25/TF-IDF search for GuideKit SDK
- [@guidekit/plugins](packages/plugins/README.md): Plugin system for GuideKit SDK
- [@guidekit/react](packages/react/README.md): React bindings for GuideKit SDK — Provider, hooks, and Widget
- [@guidekit/server](packages/server/README.md): Server-side utilities for GuideKit SDK — token generation, auth middleware
- [@guidekit/vad](packages/vad/README.md): Silero VAD model for GuideKit SDK — voice activity detection via ONNX Runtime
- [@guidekit/vanilla](packages/vanilla/README.md): Vanilla JS bundle for GuideKit SDK — script-tag integration

## Apps

- [apps/docs](apps/docs/): Documentation site (Nextra)
- [apps/example-nextjs](apps/example-nextjs/): Reference Next.js integration

## Scripts

- `pnpm skills:sync` — link skills for agent discovery
- `pnpm check` — build, typecheck, lint, test
- `pnpm stats` — package LOC report
- `pnpm llms:generate` — regenerate this file
